chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Al-Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
That they both disliked sailing the sea for trade.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on traveling by sea for trade according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi records the specific disapproval (karāhah) of Imams al-Baqir and al-Sadiq regarding sea travel for trade, reflecting the significant risks and uncertainties inherent in maritime commerce during the early Islamic era. While not constituting a strict prohibition (kaffāʾ), this juristic preference highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on minimizing financial peril (gharar) and ensuring stability in livelihood sources.
